modules.module_title: Select a suitable site for mariculture

pcs.pc_description: select a site that contains clear seawater, receives moderate rainfall throughout the year, and has suitable climatic conditions
check the site has the recommended depth and quality of water for mariculture activities
ensure that the site is not covered with coral reefs, seagrass, mangrove, etc.
ensure that the site is located far from sewage and industrial discharge and doesn’t experience strong water currents

modules.module_title: Procure seeds of organisms for culture activities

pcs.pc_description: identify the species and type of seeds required for the specific marine aquaculture system
select a source of quality seeds
procure the seeds in the required quantity

modules.module_title: Fabricate and install the pen/ raft/ cage

pcs.pc_description: procure cost-effective and durable material for fabricating the pen/ raft/ cage
co-ordinate with a fabricator for the fabrication of pen/ raft/ cage
install the pen/ raft/ cage at the selected site and secure it using anchors and ropes
install nets of the recommended mesh size

modules.module_title: Stock the seeds

pcs.pc_description: consider the capacity of cages before stocking the seeds
acclimatise the seeds before stocking them
follow the recommended prophylactic measures before stocking the seeds to protect them from diseases and ectoparasites
stock the seeds at the recommended temperature, ensuring no damage to them
maintain the recommended stocking density for the selected species

modules.module_title: Maintain the mariculture cages and water quality

pcs.pc_description: maintain the required temperature, pH, dissolved oxygen, alkalinity and salinity levels in the mariculture cages
identify and remove predators from the cages
remove algae, aquatic weeds, and uneaten feed from the cages regularly
check the cages to ensure they are anchored in the correct position
carry out regular repair and maintenance of the cages

modules.module_title: Carry out feed management

pcs.pc_description: feed the stocked organisms with the recommended feed such as wet feed, pellets, floating feed, ensuring the required level of nutrients
follow the recommended feeding schedule for the stocked species
conduct periodic sampling to decide on feeding rate
apply appropriate changes to the feed according to the stages of growth of the organisms to ensure their optimum growth

modules.module_title: Carry out health and disease management

pcs.pc_description: follow the recommended practices to prevent the outbreak of pathogens and disease such as application of chlorine/ approved disinfectants
monitor the organisms in the mariculture cages for signs of stress and disease such as reduced feeding, erratic behaviour, spots and lesions, etc.
sample the organisms and water, and co- ordinate with an approved lab to identify the problem
identify and quarantine the diseased organisms
select an appropriate treatment according to the identified disease/ infection or consult an expert
apply the prescribed treatment in the recommended dose
monitor the quarantined organisms for signs of improvements and stock with the healthy organisms once cured

modules.module_title: Harvest the aquaculture organisms

pcs.pc_description: check the aquaculture organisms to ensure they have attained the marketable size and are ready for being harvested
select an appropriate time of the day and method to harvest the aquaculture organisms such as ring seine, hook and line, traps and pots, trawling, purse seining, etc.
prepare the fishing gears required for fish harvesting
use the appropriate tools and equipment such as dip net, drag net, cast net, portable lift net, gill nets according to the selected method
harvest the aquaculture organisms partially or completely according to the local demand and proximity to the relevant markets/ buyers
protect the aquaculture organisms from stress, damage and contamination during harvesting
maintain the record of harvested organisms

modules.module_title: Sort, grade and store the aquaculture organisms

pcs.pc_description: carry out sorting of organisms as per the relevant criteria such as species and maturity
grade the organisms manually or mechanically on the basis of appropriate quality parameters such as size and appearance
store the organisms in ideal small containers in hygienic conditions at the recommended temperature and humidity before and after processing
use crushed ice for storing the harvested fish

modules.module_title: Market the aquaculture organisms

pcs.pc_description: identify the market demand and potential buyers of the harvested aquaculture organisms
negotiate the price with the buyer(s)
pack the aquaculture organisms in appropriate containers for being transported to the market/ buyer
maintain the optimum density while packing to ensure minimum stress to the organisms during transit
follow the recommended practices to save the produce from contamination during packing and transit
arrange an appropriate mode of transport/refrigerated vans to deliver the harvest from the harvesting to the processing or market site organisms to the buyer
use the relevant e-payment method such as Aadhaar Enabled Payment System (AEPS), Unified Payment Interface (UPI), Unstructured Supplementary Service Data (USSD) payment, etc.
maintain the record of sales and payments
calculate the benefit-cost (B:C) ratio

modules.module_title: Maintain the water body and its hygiene

pcs.pc_description: follow the recommended practices to protect the aquaculture farm from different types of threats such as storms, predatory birds, harmful organisms, poachers, etc.
carry out regular maintenance of the dykes and fences in the culture pond
identify and remove the preying organisms from the culture pond or tank
remove sludge, algae, uneaten feed and any other waste materials from the culture pond or tank
apply the necessary disinfectants or preventive treatment in the culture pond or tank to prevent disease outbreak and the growth of harmful organisms

modules.module_title: Maintain the health of cultured organisms

pcs.pc_description: follow the recommended practices to protect the cultured organisms from the air, water or fomite-borne contamination and diseases
sample the cultured organisms regularly to identify the signs of stress/ disease/ phenotypic disorders and the presence of parasites and pathogens
identify, quarantine and treat the unhealthy organisms following the recommended practices
monitor the quarantined organisms for signs of improvement and restock them in the culture pond or tank on complete recovery
remove the dead and moribund organisms and dispose them in an environment-friendly manner

pcs.pc_description: check the relevant Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) before use and repair or replace it, as required
use the relevant PPE during various aquaculture operations such as the application of hazardous chemicals
use the recommended soap or sanitiser to keep hands sanitised
store hazardous chemicals, tools and equipment in the safe storage area to avoid personal harm or injury
administer first-aid to the injured personnel and co-ordinate with the emergency services for further medical attention

modules.module_title: Check feasibility and select a site for pearl culture

pcs.pc_description: conduct a feasibility study to determine profitability in carrying out pearl culture such as costs involved in the maintenance of a pearl culture farm, labour, hiring a grafting technician, etc.

select a suitable site for pearl culture with the prior presence of pearl oysters, recommended temperature and salinity levels, clean water away from industrial discharge and sewage, recommended depth, mild water currents and winds, etc.

modules.module_title: Procure and condition the pearl oysters

pcs.pc_description: select the appropriate species of oysters considering the type of pearl to be produced and the local climate, their stages of development, etc.
check the availability of a reliable source of pearl oysters
procure hatchery-produced pearl oysters or collect from the wild in the required quantity
use disinfected water or recommended chemicals to condition the oysters and prevent bacterial/ fungal/ protozoan infections

modules.module_title: Set up the marine water pearl culture farm

pcs.pc_description: arrange the material required for setting the pearl culture farm such as bamboo/ lightweight timber for rafts and sealed plastic drums/ mild steel barrels for floats, coir or synthetic ropes, anchors, etc.
prepare the rafts and floats in the recommended size and tie them using ropes
apply anti-saline/ anti-corrosive paint if using steel barrels as floats
install the rafts and floats in the water body according to the wind direction
moor the rafts in the water using anchors to prevent them from breaking free

modules.module_title: Graft and transfer pearl oysters to the pearl farm

pcs.pc_description: select healthy oysters of the required characteristics for grafting
ensure the oysters starve for the recommended period before the grafting operation
co-ordinate with a grafting technician to prepare the grafts
check that grafting is done as per the required quality standards
create a scalpel slit in the soft tissue near the reproductive organ of the host oyster
insert the graft into the slit after opening the host oyster using the necessary tools and equipment such as wedges and pliers
insert nucleus in the scalpel slit to provoke the host oyster to cover the nucleus with pearl nacre
maintain the oyster in water for the recommended period
carry out x-ray examination of the oysters to check if the implant has been successful
transfer the oysters with the successful implant to the pearl farm ensuring no damage to them
place the oysters in lantern baskets/ pocket nets attached to the rafts and suspend into water
maintain the recommended spacing among the lantern baskets/ pocket nets to ensure healthy growth of pearl oysters

modules.module_title: Maintain the water body

pcs.pc_description: carry out regular cleaning to remove fouling organisms from the water body and oyster shells, ensuring no damage to the oysters
filter the recommended quantity of water in the water body regularly to provide adequate feed to pearl oysters in the form of algae and other small organisms
inspect the floats regularly to ensure they are anchored firmly in the correct position
identify and remove predators from the water body
protect the pearl farm from exposure to extreme temperatures, dirt, chemicals, vandalism and theft

modules.module_title: Maintain the pearl oysters

pcs.pc_description: monitor the pearl oysters regularly to identify the signs of stress and disease
apply the appropriate treatment in the recommended dose to cure the unhealthy pearl oysters
maintain the record of treatment used in the water body
identify, remove and dispose the dead pearl oysters and other waste safely as per the recommended practices
maintain the oysters in the water body for the recommended duration

modules.module_title: Harvest and market the pearl oysters

pcs.pc_description: check the pearls oysters to ensure the pearls have achieved the sufficient coating for being harvested
collect the lantern baskets/ pocket nets from the water body and retrieve the pearl oysters
transport the pearl oysters to the processing unit in a cool and moist environment
use the appropriate equipment to split open the oysters and cut the pearl bags to remove the pearls
dry the harvested pearls to the recommended level to protect against loss of lustre
sort and grade the harvested pearls on the applicable parameters
market the pearls and maintain the records of sales and payments
